items.html: And know that although the order of the clothing of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik in the ten Sefirot of AA was explained, and in truth this is his main and essential clothing, nevertheless, certainly, since Atik begins to enter and clothe within AA through the feet of Atik in the Rosh of AA, when AA was born and descended to Beria, and returned and ascended and clothed Atik from his feet, and ascended to his seven lower [Sefirot], as above. And it is exactly like ZA clothing AVI little by little in the entry of his Mochin, until he clothes all their seven lower [Sefirot]; and so is the matter here, except that I do not wish to elaborate on it, for it is a high place, and from there you will know it and understand it from the conclusion of the matter.
